newsitem.title: USA: Tomra sees September start in Michigan.
newsitem.headline: Tomra sees September start in Michigan.

text.p: Tomra Systems A/S said Friday it sees a September start up of activities in Michigan where it reached a tentative agreement Thursday with the Michigan SoftDrink Association to provide statewide container pickup and processing services.

The negotiated terms must be formalized and incorporated in a binding contract which is expected to be completed within 30 days, Tomra said. This development, after months of negotiation, clears the way for ramp up of activities in anticipation of a September 1997 startup, it added.

The final form of agreement resulted in a cost plus profit fee arrangement, Tomra said. While this limits some of the company's upside profit potential, it also limits downside risk. Earnings will also be impacted by the inclusion of its project partner, Schupan.

It said first year revenues are expected to be $7.1 million with potential to reach annual revenues of $18.0 million. The initial contract will be for 5 years with an option for renewal for another 5 years.
